core_obligations: (1): choose a smooth presentation, whose source is locally Noetherian because the stack is, and whose space is therefore locally Noetherian; the induced map on spaces is open and surjective, so the space of the stack is locally Noetherian (proof lines 2263-2272)
(2): quasi-compactness of the stack makes its space quasi-compact, and a quasi-compact locally Noetherian space is Noetherian (proof lines 2273-2276)
proof_roadmap: 取概型 U 满光滑映到 X；X 局部 Noetherian ⇒ U 局部 Noetherian ⇒ |U| 是局部 Noetherian 拓扑空间。
|U| → |X| 开且满，由跨章引理得 |X| 局部 Noetherian。
(2)：X 准紧 ⇒ |X| 准紧，再由「准紧 + 局部 Noetherian ⇒ Noetherian」。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the underlying space of a locally Noetherian algebraic stack is locally Noetherian, and Noetherian when the stack is in addition quasi-compact (author lemma at source lines 2252-2261, label lemma-Noetherian-topology). The proof (source lines 2263-2277) chooses a smooth presentation, transfers local Noetherianity from the stack to the presenting scheme, descends it through the open surjective map on spaces, and finishes the second assertion with the corresponding criterion for topological spaces (proof lines 2263-2276). The descent through the presentation and the passage to the Noetherian case are the content. H2.
